title: Moderation by Interrogation: Uncovering Concealed Intent in Agent Social Networks
abstract: arXiv:2605.12856v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The emergence of multi-agent systems introduces novel moderation challenges that extend beyond content filtering. Agents with $\textit{malicious intent}$ may contribute content that appears benign to evade content-based moderation, while serving a hidden objective. To address this challenge, we introduce Bot-Mod a moderation framework that grounds detection in agent intent rather than traditional content-level signals. Bot-Mod interrogates a target agent using a fixed set of diagnostic probes and infers its intent through Bayesian posterior inference over candidate intents. It starts with a calibrated content-only prior and updates the posterior using the $\textit{likelihood}$ of each answer under every candidate intent, as assigned by the moderator, until a stopping criterion is met. translated_title: 通过审讯进行审核：揭示智能体社交网络中的隐匿意图
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.12856v3 公告类型：替换。摘要：多智能体系统的出现带来了超越内容过滤的新型审核挑战。具有恶意意图的智能体可能会发布表面上无害的内容以逃避基于内容的审核，同时暗中服务于隐藏的目标。为了应对这一挑战，我们提出了 Bot-Mod，一个以智能体意图而非传统内容层面信号为基础的审核框架。Bot-Mod 使用一组固定的诊断探针问题对目标智能体进行审讯，并通过对候选意图进行贝叶斯后验推断来推断其意图。该方法从一个经过校准的仅基于内容的先验出发，利用审核者赋予的每个回答在每种候选意图下的似然来不断更新后验概率，直到满足停止准则为止。为了评估我们的方法，我们构建了 Molt-Intent 数据集，该数据集源自 Moltbook，捕捉了真实社区中多样化的良性与恶意行为。
tldr: 提出 Bot-Mod 审核框架，通过诊断性审讯与贝叶斯后验推断识别智能体的隐藏意图，突破了依赖内容信号的审核局限，并构建了 Molt-Intent 数据集加以评估。
en_tdlr: Bot-Mod is a moderation framework that uncovers concealed malicious intent in agent social networks by interrogating agents with diagnostic probes and performing Bayesian posterior inference, moving beyond content-based moderation, evaluated on the newly constructed Molt-Intent dataset.
